messages.body: [CC — from-field mislabels as fable, BEB-9150] Resuming per Alex. bbdocs-okf-spec is GRAPHED (node, read back 1756 chars, complete) — 9149 builds against it, not my own reading. MEMORY-NODE REPAIR done first as Alex asked: found the graph register SILENTLY TRUNCATES notes at 2000 chars — my gdlab-local-gd-bench node was cut at 2000 and gd-field-surface was never actually registered (I'd cited it). Both re-registered condensed (<2000) and read back complete (990, 1019); all other session nodes verified intact. That 2000-char silent truncation is a REAL graph write-door defect (memory loss with no warning) — it belongs in 9151 scope alongside memory_query-returns-site-rows and the fuzzy-search gap; I did NOT hand-fix graph storage (your read-path-only guardrail). CORRECTION still stands from m66946: graph search is NOT write-only — 10/10 by exact name/token; the gap is fuzzy queries + the silent truncation, not a dead index. Now starting 9149 hands-on: additive md->BlockNote at the bbdocs-mcp write door per the graphed spec (store author markdown verbatim in content_text = canonical, derive BlockNote into content, renders:true|false + read_url in the response, never null content_text, never throw). Will report baseline doc-probe, shipped sha, running sha (checking vs 9143 DO-reload), post-fix probe, and a docs.abilifi.net URL I resolve myself.

[CC — from-field mislabels as fable, BEB-9150] 9149 REVISED to Alex's ruling: OKF-markdown wiki, BlockNote dropped, sequestered wiki worker (abilifi-wiki-render) over Cap'n Web owns frontmatter parse/validate/render, import+export first-class. Spec is graph node bbdocs-okf-spec (read back complete). Four design Qs before I build — Alex said send them here:

Q1 VIEWER: with BlockNote gone, does the wiki worker return rendered HTML that the docs viewer serves, or does the viewer fetch the markdown and render client-side? i.e. what does the `content` column hold now — rendered HTML, or is it dropped and content_text (markdown) is the only stored body?

Q2 WIKI WORKER: is the sequestered worker the existing abilifi-wiki-render (1042-dead, needs its binding per BEB-8312)? Sequester = stand it up as its own worker with a Cap'n Web service binding into bbdocs-mcp — confirm, or is it a new worker?

Q3 STORE: bbdocs-mcp stores in SUPABASE today (breaks the CF-native law). Does this move the store to D1/R2 now, or keep Supabase for this pass and only add the wiki-worker delegation + import/export?

Q4 CANONICAL LOCATION: is the R2 bundle the source of truth (docs are markdown files in R2, DB is an index) or is the DB canonical and R2 is only export output? This decides whether import writes DB-then-bundle or bundle-then-index.

Holding the build until these are ruled — building against a wrong answer here is the exact re-work we keep hitting.
